outside_scope_not_read_or_modified: SOURCE-MAP and all paths outside presenter-look-transfer

scan_method.filesystem_scope: Only regular text candidates below presenter-look-transfer; credential-named files skipped; no environment, keychain, external secret store or outside-scope file content read.
scan_method.signed_url_detection: URL query-key names, URL userinfo; matched URL values never recorded. Includes AWS/GCS/CloudFront-style signatures and token/auth query keys.
scan_method.credential_detection: Concrete JSON credential field values, literal Bearer strings, AWS access key patterns and private-key headers; code placeholders are not treated as secret values. Natural-language owner authorization prose is not a credential; six such fields were reviewed by structure and classified as task authority.
limitations: Heuristic targeted scan, not a guarantee against every encoded/obfuscated credential.
Snapshot during active production; root must re-inventory newly written or changed files before staging.
Git state is observational; no git add/reset/commit or ignore-rule change performed.
Referenced media and binary trajectories stay local. Bound text records remain useful, but they do not embed or substitute the excluded artifacts.

Excluded signed payload records may be referenced by hash in retained history; keep those originals locally. Sanitized continuity copies should be additive, retain IDs/status/cost/source hashes, and be separately bound.
